notes.title: ✨ WONDERS - PART 2. TREASURES THAT BREATHE
notes.notes:
A Wonder is not a mute card. It is a living ally with its own temper.
Rescue Vasilisa the Wise, and every three days she offers up a freshly forged weapon-like a traveling blacksmith-and that blade might be the one that saves the whole team.
Keep Ryaba the Hen close, and every second day a shiny golden egg rolls into your hands-a cheerful backup fund for your next trades.

[h2]🔨 They work while you rest[/h2]
These Wonders generate gear or gold on their own. The longer the journey, the greater the profit.

[h2]🥚 They spark courage[/h2]
Extra blades and golden coins whisper: “Go one more day.” That whisper often becomes the difference between retreat and triumph.

[h2]🛡️ Easy to lose[/h2]
A Trickster Fox might snatch Ryaba or even poor Kolobok if you’re not watching. And Zmey Gorynych loves kidnapping maidens. The Tsar’s decree warns: your treasures can be stolen, frozen, or blown away.

[h2]👑 Cornerstones of the next victory[/h2]
Bring a Wonder home and the Tsar rewards you. Push onward, and the same Wonder becomes the backbone of the next, more dangerous adventure-multiplying its worth.

notes.title: 🧩 CORE GAMEPLAY FEATURES
notes.notes:
You’re not just playing cards - you’re leading a hero. A real one. On a royal quest for a Wonder.

[h2]🧝 Friends can join[/h2]
On your path, you'll meet allies. Some will fight by your side. Others vanish after one battle. But each one can change the course of your journey.

[h2]🗡️ Craft. Buy. Scavenge. Survive.[/h2]
Forge weapons at a smithy. Buy from wandering merchants. Whatever it takes - be ready. Enemies won’t forgive weakness.

[h2]🃏 Merges can be tricky[/h2]
Some card combinations are obvious. Some are surprising.
 And some... can go terribly wrong.
 We won't tell you which. You’ll learn the hard way.

[h2]✝️ Chainmail, a sword, and a cross - your best friends[/h2]
Armor protects. Weapons strike. And sacred talismans? They save lives. Trust them.

notes.title: ✨ WONDERS - BOTH REWARD AND TRIAL
notes.notes:
The Tsar doesn’t just send you off on a stroll - he sends you to find a Wonder.
And each one is truly unique.

[h2]🧿 Some are easy, some are earned in blood[/h2]
A few may come cheap. Others lie hidden behind fierce monsters and treacherous roads. The rarer the Wonder, the tougher the trial - and the greater the thrill.

[h2]🛡️ Keep it safe — or lose it all[/h2]
Finding a Wonder is only half the job.
You must finish your adventure with it still in hand. Some foes may try to snatch it. Some events may cost you dearly. Don’t let it slip away.

[h2]👑 The Tsar rewards the loyal[/h2]
Each Wonder you bring back earns you a reward. But go straight into the next adventure without resting — and the Tsar grows more generous.
Each consecutive journey increases the value of your Wonder.

[h2]❓Will you risk it?[/h2]
Strange things await you down the road — things you’ve never seen before.
Will you take what you’ve got and run?
Or brave the unknown, chasing something greater?

notes.title: 🔁 A HARD-WON VICTORY
notes.notes:
Zmey Gorynych is down, Baba Yaga fled in her mortar, Koschey lost his needle?
Congratulations - you’ve claimed a Wonder. That was the goal of your journey.

[h2]🏁 Head home… or push your luck?[/h2]
After every victory, you get a choice:
End the adventure - return home with your loot and keep everything you’ve gathered.
Keep going - head straight into the next journey, carrying all your cards and resources with you.

[h2]🎒 Your deck stays with you[/h2]
All the cards you’ve crafted or discovered stay in your hand. Food, weapons, companions - everything that brought you victory can be used again. But beware: the enemies will grow tougher, and the path more perilous.

[h2]🎁 The stakes get higher[/h2]
Each consecutive journey brings greater rewards. The longer you survive, the more valuable your Wonders and trophies become. But if you lose - everything you’ve gathered during this streak is gone.

[h2]⚖️ It’s fair and square[/h2]
This is pure risk-reward. Want to play it safe? Head back.
Ready to gamble? The road is open.
It’s your call.
What do you do with the Wonders, and why keep going? We’ll reveal that in the next post.

notes.title: 🃏 WHAT THE GAME IS ABOUT
notes.notes:
In Like a Fairytale, you play as a hero from Slavic folk tales. Every morning, the Tsar sends you on a quest - to retrieve a Wonder. Sometimes he doesn't even know what exactly he's looking for - and that’s when a true adventure begins.

[h2]🗺️ Adventure is a chain of random days[/h2]
Each journey lasts a random number of days - sometimes just a short outing, other times a nearly week-long trek. You never know in advance how long it will go. That’s where the thrill lies: keep going, and the risk grows — but so do the rewards.

[h2]⚔️ Each day is an event[/h2]
A monster to fight, a kind stranger, a trap, a merchant, or a mysterious find - every day brings something new. You must choose how to react: play your cards, spend your resources, adapt. The world keeps shifting - and you have to keep up.

[h2]👹 At the end - a unique boss[/h2]
Every adventure ends with a challenging and unique boss. Brute force won’t cut it - you’ll need to strategize, pick the right cards, and make the most of what you’ve got. Each boss has their own rules, tricks, and fighting style.

[h2]🎁 The reward is a Wonder[/h2]
Defeat the boss, and you’ll earn a Wonder - a rare, magical trophy that started it all. It might be an enchanted hen, a talking creature, or a mystical item. Some Wonders carry over to future adventures. And if you’re feeling brave - you can set out again immediately.

[h2]♻️ Replays stay fresh[/h2]
Each adventure is procedurally generated. New events, enemies, rewards, and even journey length - everything changes. That keeps every run exciting, unpredictable, and worth playing again.
